findings.errorText: 文字数が正しくありません。
findings.guidanceRef: GovTech Tokyo Input Form Guidance v1.1, p.27 item 4 (sufficient maximum length); also item 1 (one full-name field accommodates middle and compound names)
findings.observation: The single お名前 field kept the full 28-character name but showed the error 文字数が正しくありません。 next to it, and the agent stopped before the confirmation screen. The agent also reported that the time select showed no options, which was not measured and is not part of this finding.
findings.relevance: A person with a name of this shape, with two middle names and a compound family name, is an intended user of a contact form. The baseline name 山田 太郎 and shorter Latin names (16 characters, with spaces, diacritics and hyphens) all reached confirmation, so the rejection is tied to this name's length.
findings.basis: This is inconsistent with p.27 item 4 of the guidance, which says to set a sufficient maximum length because foreign names need more characters. It also conflicts with item 1, which says one full-name field should fit middle and compound names.
findings.cause: A character-count rule rejects the name somewhere between 17 and 28 characters, as the error text states. No maxlength or pattern attribute was visible in the DOM, so this cause is reproduced from behaviour and not confirmed in source.
findings.fix: Raise the length limit in the site's name validation (JS and server) to at least 100 characters, and add a matching maxlength="100" on input[name=flname] so the limit is visible. Keep the empty-value check and the over-limit rejection so invalid input is still refused.

findings.observation: nanoru's own checkpoint measurement matched only the prefix 2026年11月 of the requested date 2026年11月20日 on the confirmation screen. This is a nanoru diagnostic (prefix match), not text the website displayed as an error, and the name Sukarno was shown in full.
findings.relevance: This field is a reservation date, not a name field, so it says nothing about how the site handles a person with a single name. The single-name case otherwise reached the confirmation screen with the name intact.
findings.basis: The name guidance on p.27 does not cover date fields, so there is no matching recommendation.
findings.cause: Unclear: the confirmation row may split or format the date differently, or the day may really be dropped. The evidence is ambiguous until the review row in step-17.jpg is checked by hand.
findings.fix: No site change is proposed until the review row is verified. If the day is dropped, render the full submitted 日付 value on the confirmation screen and keep the existing required-date check.
